title: Wan Sheng Jie
titleNative: 万圣街
synopsis: The kind-hearted demon Neil dreams of living in the Human world when he's invited by his best friend, a vampire named Ira, to come to All Saints Street. His roommates in room 1031 are angles, mummies, and other "non-humans". Though he lives this tumultuous communal life with his roommates, within Neil lies the sleeping power...of the Demon King. Because of that power, a werewolf and Neil's demon brother also travel to the Human World. Will Neil be able to live a regular life in the Human World!? It's just an ordinary tale about the ordinary lives of non-ordinary people. (Source: Official Website)

title: World End Economica
titleNative: WORLD END ECONOMiCA
synopsis: Roughly 16 years after the people who emigrated to the Moon had settled themselves. An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A young boy named Hal, born and raised on the Moon, is one of those people chasing his wildest dream. His dream, is to stand where no man has before. In order to do so, he needed capital. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. There are only two key rules that govern that land. "The first rule, is to never take a loss. The second rule, is to never forget the first." Only those who followed these rules were able to obtain enormous wealth. The stock market. A place that has gathered crowds of persistent men and women for centuries. (Source: WEE Official)

synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! synopsis: "Please make me your disciple!!!" Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice. Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?! (Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.
